github_home.result: Navigation shell renders; animated hero stays hidden by author opacity:0. One of the initial normal page loads crashed; subsequent repeated loads survived. Remains unresolved.

github_repository.result: File listing, navigation and sidebar visibly rendered at desktop size; clean shutdown.

thingiverse.result: Navigation and page layout render. Featured content does not populate: token refresh/content API returns a 403 challenge page. This delivery restriction is classified separately from renderer behavior.

amazon.result: Canvas text causes InvalidSfnt in the bitmap build, followed by a disconnected paint channel. Deterministically reproduced using a local fixture.

implementation.status: optimized release built; native fixture checks passed; system installation unchanged
implementation.change: Rasterize native monochrome glyphs via FreeType and trace their exposed pixel contours for ordinary canvas path filling/stroking. Preserve shaping, baseline coordinates, paint, transforms, clipping, alpha and composition; bound cached faces. Do not interpret BDF/PCF as OpenType.
implementation.additional_change: Expose the standard read-only FontFaceSet.status property and track actual native loading transitions; no font downloads or API preferences enabled.

non_goals: Completing challenges or logging into any sample site
Changing privacy or adblocking policy to make pages work

canvas_candidate_live_results.amazon_home: Visible storefront, navigation, search controls, images and product cards. No canvas panic. Clean close.
canvas_candidate_live_results.amazon_books_workflow: A normal books request landed on a rendered books-category page, including image carousel and book covers. No purchase or account action taken. Clean close.
canvas_candidate_live_results.github_repository: Public repository file listing, controls and sidebar still render after the canvas change. Clean close.
canvas_candidate_live_results.github_home: Author hero content remains opacity:0 despite document.fonts.ready fulfilling; not yet resolved. No crash during this candidate run.
